rules.title: San Francisco ban on algorithmic rent-setting devices using nonpublic competitor data
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use algorithmic devices that process nonpublic competitor information to advise on rent or occupancy. Tenants can sue for damages, injunctive relief and civil penalties of up to $1,000 per violation, and each unit-month of use may count as a separate violation.
rules.requirement_es: Los arrendadores no pueden usar dispositivos algorítmicos que procesen información no pública de competidores para recomendar rentas u ocupación. Los inquilinos pueden demandar por daños, medidas cautelares y sanciones civiles de hasta $1,000 por infracción, y cada mes de uso por unidad puede contar como una infracción separada.
rules.quoted_span: The ordinance prohibits landlords from using qualifying algorithmic devices that calculate nonpublic competitor information to advise on rent or occupancy.
rules.penalty: Up to $1,000 per violation; each month for each affected unit may be a separate violation; damages and injunctive relief
rules.caveat: Secondary source (law firm summary); effective date given only to the month.

rules.title: San Diego ban on algorithmic rent-pricing coordination
rules.requirement: San Diego prohibits landlords from using algorithmic rent-pricing tools that rely on nonpublic competitor data. Tenants may sue for damages, injunctive relief and penalties of up to $1,000 per violation, with each month and affected rental property potentially a separate violation.
rules.requirement_es: San Diego prohíbe a los arrendadores usar herramientas algorítmicas de fijación de rentas que se basen en datos no públicos de competidores. Los inquilinos pueden demandar por daños, medidas cautelares y sanciones de hasta $1,000 por infracción, y cada mes y propiedad afectada puede ser una infracción separada.
rules.quoted_span: San Diego similarly authorizes tenant suits for damages, injunctive relief and penalties of up to $1,000 per violation, with each month and affected rental property potentially constituting a separate violation.
rules.penalty: Up to $1,000 per violation; damages and injunctive relief
rules.caveat: Secondary source (law firm summary); effective date given only to the month; citation range §§ 98.1101–98.1104.

rules.title: Berkeley ban on coordinated pricing algorithms
rules.requirement: Berkeley prohibits landlords from using coordinated rent-pricing algorithms. Violations can recur by unit and by month, and private parties may seek remedies.
rules.requirement_es: Berkeley prohíbe a los arrendadores usar algoritmos coordinados de fijación de precios de alquiler. Las infracciones pueden repetirse por unidad y por mes, y los particulares pueden solicitar remedios.
rules.quoted_span: Prohibits coordinated pricing algorithms; recurring unit/month violations and private remedies
rules.caveat: Secondary source; effective date given only to the month. The RealPage challenge (RealPage, Inc. v. City of Berkeley) was voluntarily dismissed with prejudice Jan. 14, 2026.

rules.title: Santa Ana ban on automated rent price-fixing
rules.requirement: Santa Ana prohibits specified anticompetitive automated rent price-fixing by landlords. Tenants may bring claims for up to $1,000 per violation and per month.
rules.requirement_es: Santa Ana prohíbe la fijación automatizada y anticompetitiva de precios de alquiler por parte de los arrendadores. Los inquilinos pueden presentar reclamos de hasta $1,000 por infracción y por mes.
rules.quoted_span: Ordinance NS-3090 prohibits specified anticompetitive automated rent price-fixing; private tenant claims and up to $1,000 per violation and per month.
rules.effective_date_quote: Santa Ana Ordinance No. NS-3090 (effective April 2, 2026)
rules.penalty: Up to $1,000 per violation and per month; private tenant claims

rules.title: Jersey City ban on algorithmic rent coordination services
rules.requirement: Landlords in Jersey City may not use algorithmic rent coordination services. The ordinance is enforced both publicly and privately, with fines up to $2,000 per day.
rules.requirement_es: Los arrendadores en Jersey City no pueden usar servicios algorítmicos de coordinación de rentas. La ordenanza se aplica tanto pública como privadamente, con multas de hasta $2,000 por día.
rules.quoted_span: Prohibits a landlord’s use of algorithmic rent coordination services; includes public and private enforcement; fines up to $2,000 per day.
rules.penalty: Fines up to $2,000 per day; public and private enforcement
rules.caveat: Secondary source; effective date given only to the month.

rules.title: Hoboken ban on software/algorithm rent coordination
rules.requirement: Hoboken landlords may not use software, algorithms or data-sharing platforms to coordinate or recommend rents, lease terms, or occupancy.
rules.requirement_es: Los arrendadores de Hoboken no pueden usar software, algoritmos ni plataformas de intercambio de datos para coordinar o recomendar rentas, términos de arrendamiento u ocupación.
rules.quoted_span: Prohibits landlords from using software, algorithms or data-sharing platforms to coordinate or recommend rents, lease terms, or occupancy.
rules.caveat: Secondary source; citation given as 'ch. 158-2'; effective date given only to the month; penalties not described.
